title: Hearty Portuguese Poppy Seeds Casserole
description: A malty and velvety Portuguese dish featuring ground poppy seeds, this casserole is a romantic and high-protein-friendly option for a special occasion, with a rich flavor profile that is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the sliced portuguese sausage until browned.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
In a large bowl, whisk together the malted milk, eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked sausage and onion mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Stir in the ground poppy seeds and cooked chicken breast.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Broil the casserole in the preheated oven for 5 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and bake for an additional 25 minutes, or until the casserole is set.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
